title: In the full profile, files must hold exactly the revision's shape files with the tree's blob ids, for the base as for the head; a .shape file outside shape/ is a raw identity and is not listed

assert.why: A.16.1(b): files list exactly shape.lock and shape/fc.shape with the trees' blob ids, commits and manifests agree (A.16.1(d)); Core has no claims, so nothing is owed
A.10.1: no shape, coherence or input-integrity error
no claim, no loosening (the shapes are identical), no coverage need (A.7.4.5)
A.3.1.1, A.12.7.3, A.16.1(b): the head's shape/fc.shape text does not have the head tree's blob id, so the input is invalid
A.12.7.3, A.16.1(b): the head tree holds shape/extra.shape, a shape file, which head.files omit
A.3.1.1, A.16.1(b): head.files list shape/ghost.shape, which the head tree does not hold

A.16.1(f): the base files CI supplies are input integrity, not base shape content, so A.10.2's "never because of the base" does not apply; the base's shape/fc.shape does not match the base tree's blob
A.3.1.1, A.16.1(b): docs/notes.shape is not under shape/, so it is a raw identity (raw:docs/notes.shape) and files rightly omit it
